name: field-flash-healing-gem
about: v530 Field Flash: Healing Gem (BS73-080) is used from the Hand as a Flash with a Contractor Morrigan (BS73-CX02) in play, refreshes an exhausted Prismwing Spirit, then is put onto the Field (PUT_SELF_ONTO_FIELD, p.fieldMag) instead of the Trash. From the Field its Activate (zone field, cost discardSelf) discards it to deploy a Contractor Morrigan from the Trash/Soul State without paying the cost.
